project_name: Treesh - This or That Lyric Game Redesign
archetype: Luxury & Electric Retro-Futurism Hybrid (Music & Turntable Craft)
emotional_tone: High-octane head-to-head battle, premium vinyl culture, electric neon glow, tangible audio craftsmanship

fonts.display: Special Gothic Expanded One (via .font-display class) for main headers, badges, champion callouts
fonts.digital_counters: Doto (via .font-doto class) for matchup counts, streak counter numbers, timer displays
fonts.body: Manrope (var(--main-font)) for track titles, artist names, button labels, and body text

hierarchy.track_title: text-sm sm:text-base font-bold line-clamp-1 text-white tracking-tight
hierarchy.champion_heading: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-300 via-amber-400 to-amber-200

layout.viewport_constraints: 100dvh full-screen modal overlay. Zero scrolling required at 390x800 phone resolution.

phone_layout.top_header: Height ~52px: Close X left/right, centered Matchup pill, Streak flame + counter, Skip dots + Skip (N left) pill
phone_layout.battle_stage: Flex-1 grid/flex with two overlapping/compact turntable decks (Deck A Top, Deck B Bottom) separated by central absolute pulse VS ring badge
phone_layout.deck_composition: Horizontal deck card (Height ~140px): Left vinyl platter (100px diameter) + Right track details & dual action buttons (Play 30s & Pick side)
phone_layout.bottom_bar: Compact control strip with Skip action button and status indicator

desktop_layout.direction: Side-by-side dual deck console centered in 1440x800 stage
desktop_layout.header: Fixed top glass header with stats and rules
desktop_layout.battle_stage: Grid 2 columns (Deck A Left vs Deck B Right) with central glowing vertical VS separator
desktop_layout.deck_composition: Full square/rectangular 3D plinth console (Width ~340px, Height ~380px) with 220px vinyl platter, full tonearm assembly on top right, bottom controls row

plinth.styling: rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/[0.07] to-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] relative overflow-hidden p-4 transition-all duration-300
plinth.screws: 4 metallic corner rivets (4px circles with radial specular reflection) for authentic vintage hardware aesthetics

platter.styling: relative rounded-full border border-white/10 shadow-inner flex items-center justify-center aspect-square
platter.strobe_dots: outer border with 36 repeating conic-gradient dots imitating turntable pitch strobe rim

vinyl.disc: rounded-full relative shadow-2xl transition-transform duration-700 ease-out flex items-center justify-center bg-[radial-gradient(circle,#20202c_0%,#111118_30%,#08080d_70%,#000000_100%)]
vinyl.grooves: repeating concentric ring overlays via CSS background radial-gradient with subtle opacity (rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) and sheen shine highlight linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 50%, transparent 60%)
vinyl.spinning_state: animate-[spin_2.5s_linear_infinite] when clip is active. Pauses cleanly when clip stops or deck is inactive
vinyl.center_label: rounded-full overflow-hidden border-2 border-amber-400/40 shadow-md aspect-square w-[38%] h-[38%] flex items-center justify-center relative
vinyl.spindle: w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-gray-400 via-white to-gray-600 border border-black/80 shadow-md z-10 absolute center

tonearm.pivot_base: absolute top-3 right-3 w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-700 via-gray-800 to-black border border-white/20 shadow-lg z-20 flex items-center justify-center
tonearm.arm_shaft: absolute top-6 right-6 w-[2px] h-20 bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-300 via-gray-400 to-gray-600 origin-top-right transition-transform duration-500 ease-out z-20 shadow-[2px_4px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
tonearm.headshell_cartridge: w-2.5 h-4 bg-amber-400/90 rounded-sm absolute bottom-0 -left-1 shadow-[0_0_8px_var(--treesh-gold)]

angles.idle: rotate-[ -28deg ] resting on armclip icon outside platter edge
angles.playing: rotate-[ 14deg ] swinging precisely onto track groove area on vinyl label border

neon_glow_treatment.vs_element: glowing neon ring pulse with dual color gradient ring border (purple side vs gold side)
neon_glow_treatment.perf_mode_fallback: Disable all drop-shadow filters and heavy backdrop-blur; fallback to solid borders and opacity state transitions

states_and_animations.idle: Both decks resting, tonearms parked at -28deg, vinyl static, full opacity on both sides
states_and_animations.playing: Active deck glows in accent color, tonearm smoothly drops to +14deg (500ms cubic-bezier), vinyl begins smooth spin. Non-playing deck dims to 0.45 opacity with slight blur
states_and_animations.picked_winner: Winner deck pulses green/purple glow, vinyl spins fast flare burst, floating streak counter +1 animation triggered
states_and_animations.loser_exit: Loser deck slides off screen (translateX(-100%) on phone or fade out scale down 0.8) with duration 400ms
states_and_animations.challenger_enter: New challenger slides in from right (translateX(100%) -> 0) with spring bounce ease

champion_end_screen.layout: Centered victory showcase card with royal gold aesthetic
champion_end_screen.header_badge: Crown icon with glowing text 'CHAMPION · MOST WINS' in gold foil style
champion_end_screen.hero_display: Large spinning gold-rimmed vinyl record with full cover art display and particle radiance backdrop
champion_end_screen.track_info: Bold display title, artist name with gold badge
champion_end_screen.stats_chips: Flex row with 'N wins this run' (Purple chip) and 'N total wins' (Gold chip)
champion_end_screen.cta_buttons: Dual primary buttons: 'Play Full Song' (Gold gradient button) and 'Play Again' (Purple glass pill button)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all HTML template strings are clean vanilla JS with Tailwind classes and inline CSS var bindings.
Ensure lucide icons are rendered with and initialized properly.
Implement data-testid attributes on all buttons, track cards, match counters, skip controls, and champion screen actions for automated test suites.
Check html.perf-mode and prefers-reduced-motion media queries to disable vinyl rotation animation and heavy blur filters when requested.
Make sure phone view (390x800) fits all controls without screen overflow or scrollbars.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or plain gradients without depth.
DO NOT use transparent headers or overlays without backdrop blur or glass tint.
Use data-testid on every interactive element using kebab-case role naming.
Respect system performance and accessibility constraints at all times.
